title: [Feature Request] Add an option to configure external diff command
body: One problem when using Claude Code without integration with an IDE is that the diff it suggests is hard to read because it does not have syntax highlighting. Adding an option to customize the diff command (like `core.pager` in `.gitconfig`) would solve the problem, because we already have good external diff commands with the syntax highlight feature (for example, https://github.com/dandavison/delta).
author: igrep
